user.title: CA Dev Thermostat Sim
user.description: Create a synthetic thermostat driven by Climate Advisor's real thermal ODE, for local multi-zone testing. Never shipped with the integration.

data.name: Name
data.off_offset_heat_f: Heat stop point past target (°F, signed; empty = -0.9)
data.off_offset_cool_f: Cool stop point past target (°F, signed; empty = -0.9)
data.heat_rate_preset: Heating rate preset (undersized 2, extreme weather 5, normal 12, oversized 18 °F/h; custom = k_active_heat)
data.cool_rate_preset: Cooling rate preset (undersized 2, extreme weather 5, normal 12, oversized 18 °F/h; custom = k_active_cool)
data.companion_sensor: Add a companion temperature sensor reporting tenths
data.edge_report_delay_s: Report heating/cooling/fan changes late by (seconds, 0 = on time; a cloud-polled thermostat)
data.blower_lead_in_heat_min: Heat blower lead-in before the burner starts (min)
data.blower_overrun_heat_min: Heat blower overrun after the burner stops (min, reported as fan)
data.coast_heat_rate_f_per_h: Furnace coast after stop (°F/h at the stop, decaying)
data.blower_lead_in_cool_min: Cool blower lead-in before the compressor starts (min)
data.blower_overrun_cool_min: AC blower overrun after the compressor stops (min, reported as fan)
data.coast_cool_rate_f_per_h: AC coil coast after stop (°F/h at the stop, decaying)

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure CA Dev Thermostat Sim
reconfigure.description: Retune this simulated thermostat's physics, comfort bounds, or tick rate without deleting and re-adding it.
